extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and furnishing a Form 8-K current report (Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure and related exhibits) including required header information, disclosures about accounting/segment reporting changes, exhibits, signature blocks, and customary forward-looking statements caution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form header and identifying information
rubrics_metrics.description: Form 8-K must include the document title (Current Report), the date of report (Date of earliest event reported), exact name of registrant as specified in charter, state or other jurisdiction of incorporation, Commission File Number, address of principal executive offices, IRS Employer Identification No., zip code, registrant's telephone number and former name or former address if changed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page shows the required header fields and the specific data AT&T provided (Date of report March 3, 2023; AT&T INC.; Delaware; 001-08610; principal office address; EIN 43-1301883; telephone). Include these items exactly in Form 8-K filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check boxes for simultaneous filing obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: Form includes check-boxes to indicate if the Form 8-K filing is intended to simultaneously satisfy the registrant’s filing obligation under any of the specified provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The four specified boxes to be considered are: (1) Written communications pursuant to Rule 425 under the Securities Act (17 CFR 230.425); (2) Soliciting material pursuant to Rule 14a-12 under the Exchange Act (17 CFR 240.14a-12); (3) Pre-commencement communications pursuant to Rule 14d-2(b) under the Exchange Act (17 CFR 240.14d-2(b)); (4) Pre-commencement communications pursuant to Rule 13e-4(c) under the Exchange Act (17 CFR 240.13e-4(c)). Check the appropriate box(es) if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b)
rubrics_metrics.description: If securities are registered pursuant to Section 12(b) of the Act, list the title of each class, trading symbol(s), and the name of each exchange on which registered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The filing lists multiple classes (e.g., Common Shares, various depositary shares and global notes) with respective trading symbols and 'New York Stock Exchange' as the exchange. Ensure each registered class in the filing is identified with symbol and exchange.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emerging growth company status and transition period election
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate by check mark whether the registrant is an emerging growth company as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act or Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act, and, if an emerging growth company, indicate if the registrant has elected not to use the extended transition period for complying with any new or revised financial accounting standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two explicit check boxes appear: one to indicate emerging growth company status and one to indicate election regarding extended transition period. Respond as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 7.01 — Regulation FD Disclosure content and filing status
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a Regulation FD Disclosure describing the issuer's public disclosure (here, the change to segment reporting and recast information) and state that the information in Item 7.01, including exhibits, 'shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference in any filing ... except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When furnishing Reg FD disclosures on Form 8-K, it is customary to include this reservation about 'filed' status and incorporation by reference. The disclosure should clearly describe the subject matter (e.g., accounting/segment reporting changes) and any exhibits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of accounting/segment reporting changes and recast
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any intended modifications to segment reporting (effective period) and explain how specific items (e.g., prior service credits) will be recorded going forward and how historical reporting has been recast to reflect the change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AT&T filing states: 'Effective for the quarter ended March 31, 2023, we intend to modify our segment reporting and no longer record prior service credit to our individual business units... Prior service credits are, and will continue to be, recorded as other income in our consolidated income statement in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles.' Provide a clear statement of the policy change, the accounting treatment, and that historical numbers have been recast as a convenience to investors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantitative impact disclosure of the recast
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose the quantitative impact of the recast on segment operating income and EBITDA for relevant years and provide segment-level breakdowns when applicable, and affirm whether there is any impact on consolidated operating income and EBITDA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AT&T provides specific amounts: 'This recast decreases our full-year Communications segment operating income and EBITDA ... by approximately $2.4 billion in 2022 (... breakdown by Mobility, Business Wireline, Consumer Wireline) and $2.1 billion in 2021 (... breakdown)... There is no impact to consolidated operating income and EBITDA.' When recasting historical results, quantify total and segment impacts and explicitly state consolidated effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of Corporate and Other recast details
rubrics_metrics.description: If recast affects Corporate and Other, describe the nature and amounts of prior service credits or other items reclassified to Corporate and Other (e.g., parent administration support, former U.S. video business amounts) and any offsets or eliminations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AT&T specifies amounts related to parent administration support and former U.S. video business and notes offsets in elimination of reclassification. Provide similar specificity and explanation of offsets when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cautionary language concerning forward-looking statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a cautionary statement that the filing contains financial estimates and forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties, refer readers to the registrant’s other SEC filings for a discussion of factors that may affect future results, and disclaim any obligation to update or revise forward-looking statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The filing's exact wording: 'Information set forth in this filing contains financial estimates and other forward-looking statements that are subject to risks and uncertainties. A discussion of factors that may affect future results is contained in AT&T’s filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission. AT&T disclaims any obligation to update or revise statements contained in this filing based on new information or otherwise.' Use comparable language tailored to the company’s circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 9.01 — Financial Statements and Exhibits list
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize exhibits being furnished as part of the report and identify each exhibit by number and brief description (e.g., 99.1 Supplemental Quarterly Segment Financial Information; 99.2 Supplemental Segment Reconciliations for the years ended December 31, 2022 and 2021; 104 Cover Page Interactive Data File).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The filing lists Exhibits 99.1, 99.2 and 104. When furnishing exhibits, enumerate and briefly describe each exhibit and its relation to the Item 7.01 disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature block and attestation
rubrics_metrics.description: Form must be signed by an authorized officer, showing the name, signature, title and date attesting that the registrant caused the report to be signed on its behalf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: 'Pursuant to the requirements... the Registrant has duly caused this report to be signed on its behalf by the undersigned hereunto duly authorized.' Followed by signature, name (Debra L. Dial), title (Senior Vice President - Chief Accounting Officer and Controller) and date. Ensure an authorized officer signs and provides title and date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exhibit 99.1 — Supplemental Quarterly Segment Financial Information (presentation requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide unaudited supplemental quarterly segment financial information presented in dollars in millions, showing operating revenues by component (e.g., Mobility: Service/Equipment; Business Wireline; Consumer Wireline: Broadband/Legacy Voice and Data/Other), operating expenses (operations and support, depreciation & amortization), operating income, operating income margin, EBITDA and EBITDA margin by quarter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AT&T furnishes detailed tables for quarters (3/31/21 through 12/31/22) with line items and margin calculations. Include clear tables and reconcile definitions/footnotes (e.g., EBITDA footnote). Ensure formatting is readable and that quarterly time series data and segment/subsegment splits are provided where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exhibit 99.1 — EBITDA definition and margin calculations
rubrics_metrics.description: Define EBITDA and explain how EBITDA and EBITDA margin (and EBITDA service margin, if used) are calculated in the exhibit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AT&T's footnote: 'EBITDA is operating income before depreciation and amortization. It excludes depreciation and amortization, interest expense, other income (expense) - net and income taxes from net income. EBITDA margin is calculated as EBITDA divided by total revenue and EBITDA service margin is calculated as EBITDA divided by service revenues.' Include clear definitions and any exclusions used in calculating non-GAAP metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exhibit 99.2 — Supplemental Segment Reconciliations (presentation and reconciliation items)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide supplemental segment reconciliations for relevant reporting periods (e.g., year ended December 31, 2022 and 2021) showing revenues, operations and support expenses, EBITDA, depreciation and amortization, operating income (loss) by segment and reconciliations for Corporate and Other — listing reconciling items such as DTV-related retained costs, parent administration support, securitization fees, value portfolio, certain significant items, video, held-for-sale and other reclassifications, eliminations and consolidations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The exhibit shows segment-level totals and the composition of Corporate reconciling items and certain significant items, and totals for AT&T Inc. Provide reconciliations and label reconciling line items explicitly so consolidated totals can be traced to segment figures.
